parameters.query: SELECT id, account, priority, from_addr, subject, body, message_id FROM brief_items WHERE classification = 'needs_reply' AND ea_drafted = false ORDER BY priority ASC, received_at ASC LIMIT 20;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 1500, system: $json.routeSystem, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.routeUser }] }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO crm_dev.ea_actions (type, account, priority, summary, detail, payload, source_message_id, dedup_key) SELECT 'email.draft', $1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6, $7 WHERE $8 = 'ea_actions' ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO NOTHING;
INSERT INTO crm_dev.attention (type, title, body, source, dedup_key) SELECT 'review', $1, $2, 'ea', $3 WHERE $4 = 'attention' ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO NOTHING;
INSERT INTO crm_dev.tasks (title, status, due_date, created_from) SELECT $1, 'open', $2, 'ea' WHERE $3 = 'tasks';
UPDATE brief_items SET ea_drafted = true WHERE id = $1;
